purpose: Define language variants, candidate coverage, and validation gates without authorizing model or language-pack downloads.

language_inventory.name: Spanish
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos package index lists English-Spanish and Spanish-English packages; exact package artifacts remain unpinned and unapproved.

language_inventory.name: English
language_inventory.variant: Modern English; proposed hub language, not an implicit pivot
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Argos index lists English as a source or target for the listed modern-language packages. Cross-language pivoting is not authorized.

language_inventory.name: Portuguese
language_inventory.variant: Portuguese; regional variant to be pinned per artifact (pt and Brazilian Portuguese pb are distinct in Argos index)
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos index lists en->pt and pt->en; Brazilian Portuguese is separately coded pb.

language_inventory.name: Russian
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos index lists English-Russian directions.

language_inventory.name: Korean
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos index lists English-Korean directions.

language_inventory.name: Chinese
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Argos index distinguishes Chinese (zh) from Traditional Chinese (zt). Treat zh as the Simplified candidate only after confirming package metadata.

language_inventory.name: Chinese
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos index explicitly labels zt as Chinese (traditional).

language_inventory.name: Japanese
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Official Argos index lists English-Japanese directions.

language_inventory.name: Ancient Greek
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Argos modern Greek code el is not evidence for Koine Greek. CLTK is a relevant analysis candidate for Greek; translation model coverage and licenses require separate proof.

language_inventory.name: Ancient Hebrew
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Argos modern Hebrew code he is not evidence for Ancient/Biblical Hebrew. Do not equate modern Hebrew packages with Biblical Hebrew translation.

language_inventory.name: Latin
language_inventory.variant: Classical and Late Latin; period must be tagged per task
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: CLTK is a relevant Latin analysis candidate. No Argos Latin package was established by the reviewed package-index evidence.

language_inventory.name: Syriac
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: No verified Argos Syriac package or specialist model artifact is approved in this change.

language_inventory.name: Aramaic
language_inventory.coverage_evidence: Biblical Aramaic is distinct from Syriac and modern Hebrew. No verified Argos package or specialist model artifact is approved in this change.

routing_policy.modern_languages: Use individually approved direct Argos pairs where available; do not silently route through English. A future explicit multi-hop route requires a separately reviewed policy, per-hop evidence, and quality tests.
routing_policy.ancient_languages: Separate translation and linguistic-analysis routes. CLTK may support tokenization, lemmatization, morphology or corpus workflows where available; it is not by itself a machine-translation engine.
routing_policy.unsupported_or_unverified_pair: Return BLOCKED with a stable gate code; never fall back silently to a different language variant or model.
routing_policy.candidate_pair_registry: ai/translation/pairs.json remains the runtime authorization source and must remain unapproved/empty until artifact-level gates pass.

acceptance_gates: Pin a dated upstream package-index snapshot and immutable source revision.
For every proposed artifact, record direct source URL, version, byte size, SHA-256, license and provenance.
Test both directions independently; do not infer reverse-direction availability from one direction.
Create versioned evaluation fixtures for each language and dialect, including named-entity, morphology, ambiguity and domain-specific cases.
For ancient languages, have a qualified reviewer score translation fidelity and linguistic-analysis outputs against cited editions or annotated corpora.
Measure cold-start RAM, steady-state RAM, CPU latency, temporary disk and installed disk in a Debian 13 Python 3.12/3.13 isolated profile.
Run CI contract tests proving unsupported pairs are blocked and no model artifact downloads occur before approval.
Only a separate explicit approval may move a pair into ai/translation/pairs.json.
